topic: Sharing Views on Online and Traditional Classroom Learning(在线学习与传统课堂学习的异同)
genre: 比较与对照 / 议论(compare and contrast two types of learning)
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 4 Moving Forward:在80-100词内分两段讨论在线学习与传统课堂学习的相同点与不同点(comparison and contrast)。
prompt_cn: 你的班级正在讨论在线学习与传统课堂学习。请用英语写两段、约80-100词,①第一段写两者的相同点;②第二段写两者的不同点。要求:用比较与对照的连接词(both / likewise / however / unlike / while 等),观点清楚、句句相关。
prompt_en: Your class is holding a discussion about online and traditional classroom learning. In about 80-100 words, write two paragraphs: 1) the similarities between the two; 2) the differences between them. Use comparison-and-contrast linking words (both, likewise, however, unlike, while), keep your ideas clear and every sentence on the point.
points: 相同点段:both 引出共同特征(都需努力、都有老师指导)
不同点段:unlike / while / however 引出差异(地点、互动、灵活度)
用比较对照连接词组织全文(both / likewise / in contrast / while)
结尾给出自己的看法或小结
model_essay:
Online and traditional classroom learning share several common features. Both ask students to study hard and to finish their tasks on time, and in both ways a teacher guides the lessons. Likewise, both help us gain real knowledge and skills.

There are also clear differences between the two. In a traditional classroom, students and teachers meet face to face, while online learning takes place through a screen at home. Online study is more flexible, because you can view a recorded lesson again whenever you like. However, a real classroom offers warmer interaction with classmates. In my view, the two ways work best together.
model_translation:
在线学习与传统课堂学习有几个共同点。两者都要求学生努力学习、按时完成任务,且都由老师指导课程。同样,两者都能帮助我们获得真正的知识与技能。

两者之间也有明显差异。在传统课堂里,师生面对面;而在线学习是在家里通过屏幕进行的。在线学习更灵活,因为你可以随时重看录播课。然而,真实课堂提供与同学更温暖的互动。在我看来,两种方式结合起来效果最好。

rubric.criteria: 两段齐全:相同点段 + 不同点段,各≥两条具体信息
比较对照结构清晰、连接词得当(both/likewise/however/while)、句句相关
句型词汇准确多样、对照句地道、语法基本无误

required_structure: 相同点开头 … share several common features.
不同点开头 There are also clear differences between the two.
不同点展开 In a traditional classroom … , while online learning … / However, …
key_expressions: Online and traditional learning share several common features.
Both ask students to study hard and finish tasks on time.
Online study is more flexible, while a real classroom offers warmer interaction.
In my view, the two ways work best together.

high_sentences: Online and traditional classroom learning share several common features.
Both ask students to study hard and to finish their tasks on time.
Online study is more flexible, while a real classroom offers warmer interaction.
In my view, the two ways work best together.

error_pairs.wrong: Both of them needs hard work.
error_pairs.correct: Both of them need hard work.
error_pairs.note: both 作主语谓语用复数 need。

error_pairs.wrong: Unlike with a classroom, online learning is flexible.
error_pairs.correct: Unlike a traditional classroom, online learning is flexible.
error_pairs.note: unlike 后直接接名词,不加 with。

error_pairs.wrong: Online learning is more flexible, but a classroom offers warmer interaction, while is fun.
error_pairs.correct: Online learning is more flexible, while a classroom offers warmer interaction.
error_pairs.note: while 表对比,连接两个对照分句,不重复连词。
